notes: `upstream` is the Isol8 PAPERCLIP FORK image (ghcr.io/isol8ai/paperclip, built by the fork's own CI from branch isol8/2026.7-circuit-breaker, tag v2026.7-isol8.5 — the 2026.7 line began as a REBASE of our patches onto upstream 2026.7 (936215693); protocol-v4 is now native upstream and was dropped, migration renumbered 0102->0182, recovery-storm throttles come native), pinned by DIGEST. The fork carries our patches in REAL SOURCE — the openclaw-gateway protocol-v4 fix (formerly a runtime sed-overlay in apps/infra/paperclip-extended/Dockerfile), the routine circuit breaker, the agent-delete routines-FK fix (delete assigned routines before the agent so DELETE /api/agents/{id} no longer 500s), honest run-log workspace/session-reset lines for cloud-adapter runs (remote workspace named instead of local-fallback noise), a 400 guard on non-UUID X-Paperclip-Run-Id headers (was an opaque 500), complete child-row cleanup on issue delete (comments/votes/interactions/read-states deleted, cost/finance ledger detached, sub-issues promoted), the agent-comment whitespace fix (openclaw-gateway pickAssistantChunk no longer trims each streamed delta, so agent-posted comments keep their spaces), and the resilient detached agent.wait (the openclaw-gateway adapter polls agent.wait in <=5-min slices and transparently reconnects across AWS API Gateway's hard 2h WS cap, instead of failing a still-executing run at a single 600s wait; bounded by a stall timeout and a 48h ceiling), and the FK-safe company delete (v2026.7-isol8.4: DELETE /api/companies/{id} deletes every company-scoped table in a topologically valid child-before-parent order via COMPANY_DELETE_SEQUENCE, so tear-down no longer 500s on issue_thread_interactions or the goals/projects ordering). The extended Dockerfile is now a thin passthrough that re-tags this image into ECR so per-tenant ECS tasks can pull it with execution-role creds (the fork GHCR package is private; the build authenticates with GITHUB_TOKEN and the package grants Isol8AI/isol8 read access). `extendedImage` + per-env `dev.tag`/`prod.tag` are the ECR-published extended image deployed to dev/prod. `upstreamCommit` is the FORK commit (drives the extended tag). Bump `upstream` here to the fork's new digest when shipping fork changes. v2026.7-isol8.5 adds the PAPERCLIP_SKIP_BUILTIN_AGENTS env gate: when set, company creation AND the startup reconcile skip auto-provisioning Paperclip's built-in starter agents (Reflection Coach/Summarizer) — Isol8 tenants must contain exactly the Isol8-seeded agents (Friday+Atlas), and the deployed BFF hard-refuses deleting built-ins (409 built_in_agent_undeletable), so not creating them is the only path. The env var is wired in paperclip-stack.ts; per-env dev/prod tags below gate the rollout. v2026.7-isol8.7 adds the bundled isol8.notifications plugin (packages/plugins/plugin-isol8-notifications): subscribes to approval.created/resubmitted + agent.run.finished/failed on the server-side plugin event bus and POSTs them to the backend /webhooks/paperclip-events receiver for push notifications; approval.resubmitted added to PLUGIN_EVENT_TYPES; buildPluginWorkerEnv passes PAPERCLIP_ISOL8_NOTIFY_URL/_TOKEN (set by paperclip-stack) to this plugin id only — plugin configJson is per-company on this line, env is the sole instance-wide channel. Unconfigured instances no-op.
